operationID.retry: same UUID for the same semantic transaction operation

signedTransactionJWS.logging: never store or echo raw JWS

request.callerControlledAuthorityFields: none: account, appAccountToken, environment, bundle, product, quantity, draw count, catalog, seed, pity, and result are not request fields

principal.source: out-of-band injected VerifiedPrincipalProvider; request body cannot assert identity
principal.default: deny before JWS processing or ledger lookup

serverPolicy.profile: fixed explicit Sandbox rehearsal profile; product allowlist, draw count, test seed, pool and candidate rules are server-side immutable configuration
serverPolicy.randomness: R459 deterministic test RNG only; never production RNG

historicalDelivery.deliveredItems: immutable candidate payload; stable gear UUIDs derived from operation UUID and ordered draw rows

currentState.freshness: read from authority APIs on each response; never copied from cached historical receipt

response.requestSHA256: hash of exact request bytes; not authentication
response.errorCode: stable enumerated code or null; never includes token, JWS, raw payload, private key or filesystem path

sideEffects.ledger: existing R459 capability-bound rehearsal authority only; no duplicate purchase/draw SQL
sideEffects.save: no game-save write in Python service

acceptance: default provider rejects before JWS verification or ledger lookup
principal/account/token mismatch rejects before ledger mutation
strict request schema and canonical UUID validation
same operation retry returns same historical delivery and a fresh current-state snapshot
changed transaction under the same operation UUID is rejected by ledger idempotency collision
refund/debt state is freshly reflected and cannot be replaced by an old successful delivery
successful and rejected responses never claim production authorization
